headline: Wingtech Rejects Nexperia Restructuring Plan, Citing Discrimination
summary: Shanghai-listed Wingtech Technology rejected a restructuring proposal that would remove its control over Dutch chipmaker Nexperia's assets outside China, condemning the plan as expropriation.
why: Cross-border ownership disputes over semiconductor assets highlight geopolitical friction in global technology supply chains and can disrupt corporate governance and capital structures.
